# bugs #3077: Names, regression tests, and port coverage of the functions _itoa, _uitoa, _ltoa, and _ultoa

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3077/
- Category: [Already fixed in trunk](../../fixed-upstream.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Close as fixed in r11731. Decide separately on the pdk patch for __ltoa in comment 23, which is not applied.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The ticket asks for names with two underscores, for regression tests, and for the functions in
the library of every port. On r17176 the first two requests are met, and the third is met for
mcs51.

`device/include/stdlib.h` declares `__uitoa`, `__itoa`, `__ultoa`, and `__ltoa` and does not
declare the names with one underscore. A program that calls the four functions twelve times with
radix 2, 8, 10, and 16 and compares the strings gives twelve correct results in ucsim. It was run
for mcs51 with the small, medium, large, and huge models and with `--stack-auto` for small and
large. The program also links for z80 and stm8, where it was not run.

The regression test `itoa` passes on r17176 for the same six mcs51 configurations, and `ltoa`
passes for five of them. An `#if` in `ltoa` disables it for the small model without
`--stack-auto`.

The pdk and PIC ports were not built, and the following facts were read in the source. The
library Makefiles of pdk13, pdk14, pdk15, and pdk15-stack-auto list `__itoa` and not `__ltoa`, so
the patch in comment 23 is not applied. `device/include/pic14/stdlib.h` declares the names with
one underscore, while the pic14 library builds `__itoa.c` and `__ltoa.c`. The pic16 library has
its own `itoa`, `uitoa`, `ltoa`, and `ultoa`.

## Fixed by

[r11731](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/11731/) renamed the functions in `stdlib.h`, the
files `device/lib/__itoa.c` and `device/lib/__ltoa.c`, and the entries in the library Makefiles.
It also added a line about the new names to the manual.
[r11720](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/11720/) added the two regression tests.
[r11726](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/11726/) added assembler versions for z80, and
[r11753](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/11753/) added them for ez80, z180, and z80n. In the
fifteenth comment a maintainer proposes to close the ticket after r11731.
